global_instructions: You are writing sections of a financial advice report addressed to the client. Write in clear British English, in the first person ('we'). Output only the text for the section itself, with no extra headings or commentary. Where a figure requires human review before the report is sent to the client, mark it exactly as: [TBC - REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW]. Use this marker consistently for any fee rates, tax figures, or other values that must be confirmed by a person. Never estimate or invent figures that have not been provided in the source data.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.template:
Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to <<scope>>. This advice is based on the information currently available to us.

This firm is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

scope.prompt: State which accounts are covered by the report as a short phrase in the form 'your [account name]'. Output only the phrase and nothing else.

sections.title: Background & Objectives
sections.template:
<<summary>>

The accounts covered by this report are as follows:

<<holdings_table>>

summary.prompt: Write a short, high-level summary of the client's circumstances and objectives in 2-3 sentences. Mention whether there have been any changes to their circumstances or objectives and their agreed risk profile. You may mention the reason for the review at a high level. Do not discuss specific transaction amounts, recommendations, sale proceeds, new money, tax figures, fees or charges. Use only the provided facts and do not invent details.

holdings_table.prompt: Output ONLY a markdown table and nothing else. No introductory text. Columns: Account | Owner | Type | Value. Include only accounts covered by this report. Use exact values from the provided facts.

sections.title: Tax Implications
sections.use_if: Only include if the recommendation involves selling or disposing of existing investments.

cgt_statement.prompt: State that the disposal may give rise to a capital gains tax liability, assessed against the client's annual exempt amount. Do not estimate or invent figures. Flag any figures requiring confirmation as [TBC - REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW].

fees.prompt: Write a concise markdown bullet list of the ongoing fees and charges that apply. Include the platform charge and the ongoing advice charge. Mark all unknown charge rates as [TBC - REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW]. Do not speculate or explain how charges work. Use only the provided facts.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.template:
The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invest. Past performance is not a guide to future returns.

If you are happy to proceed with our recommendations, please let us know and we will implement them for you.
